QuestInfo.name: In Search of Athena Pierce
QuestInfo.0: Ask around about #p1012100#. It's doubtful anyone in Maple World know about her, but it doesn't hurt to try. Start with #b#p1032104##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1032104# knows about #p1012100#! Apparently #p1012100# is the famous Bowman Job Instructor of #b#m100000000#! To think, that young girl is more well known than you? Little matter, you should go see her right away!
QuestInfo.2: After hundreds of years, you were reunited with #p1012100#. In your memory she was a whiny brat, but now she seemed even more mature than you.

0.0: Whatever you need, just ask. I owe you so much.\r\n#L0##bDo you know of anyone else like me? Someone with long hair and pointed ears? She's got potential as an archer, but she's still just a child. She's calm and kind, but very stubborn.#l\n#k
0.1: You're looking for a kid?\r\n#L0##bAh! I suppose she'd be an adult by now. She may even be quite powerful... If you hear of anyone who looks like me, please let me know. I'll repay you however I can.#l\n#k
0.2: You don't have to pay me anything! Now, if we're talking about adults, I do know of an archer with long hair and pointy ears. She famous, you know.\r\n#L0##bFamous? Could #p1012100# be famous? That's a shock...#l\n#k
0.3: Yes, #p1012100#! That's her! You really didn't know she's that famous Bowman Job Instructor? She teaches at the #m100000201# in #m100000000#. Honestly, everyone in Maple World knows of her!\r\n#L0##bSo... Athena Pierce is at the Bowman Instructional School?#l\n#k
0.4: #b#p1012100##k is usually in the #m100000201##k in #b#m100000000#, training new Bowmen. You should be able to see her right away.\r\n#b#e(You will be moved to Henesys if you accept.)#n#k

no.0: You really didn't know about #p1012100#? You really are a strange one, Mercedes. You've got that weird accent, and you don't even know about people like her. It's like you were born last century or something!

npc.0: Weren't you headed to #b#m100000000##k? #p1012100# is usually at the #b#m100000201##k inside #b#m100000000##k.
